results.title: Celtic Utopia
results.overview: The story of a new Ireland and its vibrant music scene, but also that of a postcolonial society wrestling with its heritage. A society where folk music carries both the oppression of the past and the dream of a bright future.

results.title: Good Dad
results.overview: Teenager Sasha witnesses a kidnapping, setting off a chain of events that could destroy his family.

results.title: Wild London
results.overview: After a life spent travelling the globe, the world’s most famous naturalist turns his attention closer to home to explore the wildlife of England’s iconic capital. Having lived in London for 75 years, Sir David has an intimate knowledge of the city’s natural history, and there's no better guide to introduce us to its most spectacular wildlife secrets. Captured over his centennial year, this personal and poignant film is a timely insight into how cities can become homes for wildlife as well as ourselves.

results.title: Summer on Asphalt
results.overview: Les (Mala Emde) lives life fast, spontaneously, and carefree. By day, she races through the city as a bike courier; after work, she's off partying with her friends. Stopping, pausing, or thinking about the future? Not for Les. At least not until her father, Bert (Christoph Maria Herbst) – with whom she has virtually no contact – unexpectedly shows up at her door and, after an accident, even hops on his bike for his daughter without being asked. When Les then learns of her unplanned pregnancy, she's completely thrown into a new reality. The expectant father, Tyler (Aaron Hilmer), would love a child, but unfortunately, he's still a child himself. Les's world is turned upside down – and Bert hasn't even told her yet that he's going to die soon...

results.title: Kung Fu
results.overview: Two loser high school students meet a wandering old man with unparalleled martial arts skills. Together, they not only strive to restore justice to their city but also unravel the mystery of the old man's identity.

results.title: The Face of Horror
results.overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

results.title: Ashes
results.overview: After fleeing a drug deal gone bad, vet Matt Benning tries to escape, but finds his previous problems have followed him.

results.title: Frescoes
results.overview: When returning to a childhood home, traditions reveal themselves like a cyclical nightmare.

results.title: Just Look Up
results.overview: A defiant young visionary, part stand-up comic, part young Bob Dylan, part brilliant mind, leads a disruptive climate movement reinventing protest, channeling civil disobedience, and demanding a livable future.

results.title: Chandarege Wife
results.overview: A wife tries to sustain her marriage to a filmmaker while facing hidden truths and a crumbling relationship.

results.title: Dog Years
results.overview: A woman loses a dog and enlists her inadvertent stalker to help her find it.

results.title: Memories of Insignificance
results.overview: Fifty-year-old F.P. arrives at a seaside resort. He wants to commit suicide. He has a family, money, and yet a growing aversion to life. As he begins to write a farewell letter to his wife, the ghost of his father, who committed suicide, appears. He tries to dissuade his son from killing himself.

results.title: Tony Odyssey
results.overview: Tony and his best friend, Ivy, decide to rob the bar where he works to steal a new drug that will take them on a journey to meet God.

results.title: Infinite Icon: A Visual Memoir
results.overview: Paris Hilton's musical journey unfolds through rare footage and intimate moments, from her debut album to her latest work. A raw look at her evolution as an artist and icon, blending performances with personal revelations.

results.title: Papagayo
results.overview: A month after the Hamas attack and Israel's bloody retaliation, which marks the beginning of the genocide of Palestinians in Gaza, an Israeli illustrator living in Spain breaks up with her long-term partner, a Spanish filmmaker of Syrian origin. Omar decides to continue working on the film they had been making together, using footage shot in the Middle East and the unfinished drawings left behind by his beloved. A story about religious fanaticism and its absurdities, and a painful dissection of the relationship between two people who wanted to be together despite their cultural differences.

results.title: Where the Heart Lands
results.overview: A Kentucky horse trainer's world is upended when a handsome LA lawyer inherits her stable. To stop him from selling, she and the locals drag him into the excitement of horse racing, finding love along the way.

results.title: The Audition
results.overview: After the death of his wife, widowed filmmaker Noah spirals into obsession when he meets Miya, a young woman drawn into his dark world. As his fixation grows, terror unfolds in this chilling tale of grief, manipulation, and horror.

results.title: Black Lizard / Diamond Impulse
results.overview: Black Lizard Great detective Kogoro Akechi and the enigmatic female thief Black Lizard. Within their thrilling game of pursuit and evasion, a solitary, unspoken love gradually blossoms between hunter and hunted. Diamond Impulse A shimmering diamond, bursting with the power to awaken countless emotions and impulses in us. This is a sparking stage performance that mixes IMPULSE—ephemeral feelings: the passion and love of those who keep on singing and dancing; desire and envy—with the transparent serenity and seductive scintillation of a diamond.

results.title: The King of the Internet
results.overview: The film tells the real story of Daniel Nascimento, who came to be considered one of the greatest hackers in Brazil.

results.title: Solid Food
results.overview: Claudia struggles to wean her baby alone. As breastfeeding becomes painful and the baby starts to lose weight, she seeks help from a lactation consultant, who reassures her she already is everything her baby needs…
